description: MTA Subway General Orders: Beginning 2019 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset represents each of the General Orders (GOs) that were created for the subway system since 2019 and their respective impacts on the system. GOs are made to notify operating personnel about how, when, and where service is being changed for work being done in the subway system. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are service patterns, subway lines, general orders, new york city transit, nyct. The table has 12 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
